name: GDELT DOC 2.0 news index
terms: Open; attribution to the GDELT Project

name: Google News RSS search
terms: Feed terms: personal, non-commercial use. Opt-in (--gnews); publish derived facts only.

name: Press Information Bureau (Govt. of India) press releases
notes: Returns 403 to automated clients (Akamai, Sep 2026). Read releases manually or via a browser-based Agent Reach channel.

name: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (India)
notes: Operation reports and alerts. Site did not respond from the build machine (Sep 2026).

name: CITES Trade Database (UNEP-WCMC)
terms: Free for non-commercial use with attribution to CITES Secretariat / UNEP-WCMC
notes: Annual full CSV download. Source code 'I' = confiscated/seized specimens. Loader: vannetra cites <folder>.

name: US Fish & Wildlife Service LEMIS import records
notes: US imports incl. from India/SE Asia exporters (Eskew et al. 2020, Scientific Data).

name: C4ADS WildLEO / wildlife seizure database
notes: Ivory, rhino horn and pangolin focus; access by agreement.

name: UNODC World WISE
notes: Record-level data not public; World Wildlife Crime Report gives aggregates.

name: TRAFFIC Wildlife Trade Portal
notes: Free registration; check terms before any automated use.

name: Wildlife Justice Commission reports
notes: Detailed network investigations (SE Asia, Nigeria-Vietnam routes). Good seeds for link charts.

name: Education for Nature Vietnam (ENV) wildlife crime reports
Indian Kanoon (court judgments)
terms: Paid API token; search 'Wildlife (Protection) Act' + species
notes: Collector stub not yet written. Judgments name accused persons: keep in data/private only.

name: YouTube search (metadata only)
terms: YouTube Data API terms, or yt-dlp for public metadata. Never publish channel names or contact numbers.

name: Agent Reach bridge (web, RSS, Reddit, X, YouTube, ...)
terms: MIT tool; each upstream platform keeps its own terms
notes: Uses whatever upstream tools `agent-reach doctor` reports as healthy.

name: WCS India Online Wildlife Trade (OWT) labelled set
notes: 1,274 labelled YouTube listings (R/IR). Trains the relevance model. Only aggregates are published.
